title: pprofit20 amendment A3: M1 with an isotonic calibrator instead of Platt (operator-approved)
disclosure: POST-HOC MOTIVATED. The isotonic choice was made after seeing the A2 M1 Platt results (pass XAU and NATGAS only; WTI, EUR/USD, XAG, SPX500 failed by 0.031-0.051 max decile gap) and the post-hoc isotonic diagnostic in out/diag_M1.json (isotonic max gaps 0.004-0.019 on the four failing instruments, with a tie-breaking jitter in the decile assignment). This amendment is therefore not an independent test of the calibrator; the binding confirmation stays prospective / post-2026-10-07 data.
before_registration: All A2 M1 outcomes known (out/results_*_M1.json, diag_M1.json). No A3 isotonic walk-forward was computed under this code before this file; the diag isotonic run used diag.py, not this code path.
code_change: pp20.py: PP_CAL=iso (M1 only, asserted): fit() replaces Platt with sklearn IsotonicRegression(out_of_bounds='clip') fitted on the raw LR score of the same calibration rows; prob() = numpy.interp over the knots (linear interpolation between knots, clip outside; equals sklearn predict, verify_iso.py self); artifact calibrator = {type: isotonic, x, y, out_of_bounds: clip, interpolation}; an empty decile exports null for meanR/meanR_ci; passing artifacts with median out-of-sample P < 1% get status 'degenerate: not for display'. Output suffix _M1_iso. Platt paths unchanged.
design: identical to A2 (prereg_m1.json): every 5th M1 bar (minute % 5 == 4), both sides, 18 features, LR with side interaction C = 1, quarterly expanding refit, 360-bar time exit, labels_v2.POLICY otherwise, bid/ask fills, 1R = 1.5 x Wilder ATR14 mid M1
calibrator: isotonic regression of y on the raw LR score, rows starting in the 182 days before the quarter start with exit before the quarter start (same purge as Platt); final model: the 182 days before the cutoff
deciles: unchanged function: edges = quantiles of P per side, tied P values fall in the same (upper) bin. Isotonic plateaus can make bins unequal or empty; the pass rule still applies to every per-side bin with n >= 1000 and the artifact lookup uses the same edges, so the live lookup matches the evaluation. No tie-breaking jitter (the diag.py jitter is not used)
pass_rule: unchanged: |mean P - observed| <= 0.03 in every per-side decile with n >= 1000, dev 2019-2022 and 2023+, all six instruments
exports: artifact_<INST>_M1_iso_pprofit20.json for passing instruments (status 'degenerate: not for display' if median P < 1%); parity_{WTICO_USD,EUR_USD}_M1_iso_pprofit20.json (2000 M1 bars, 80 rows, raw score and calibrated P; their artifacts are written as parity references marked NOT calibrated if they fail)
status: development evidence; no test_ledger; nothing qualified
